observation: Actual registry constructor and entry instantiate Skreecher as CREATURE despite Monster superclass. Own static placement checks nonpeaceful/darkness/SCULK and instance roll uses config with SPAWNER bypass; class/max cluster1 does not prove deployed natural biome pool/cap. These support a real called mechanism, not NATURAL spawn success.

Registered HurtByTargetGoal and player NearestTarget3D consumer can feed FollowTargetGoal. Anonymous target search uses bounding box inflated16 inX/Z and fixedY[-64,320], overriding helper cube. Follow canUse needs own live target and clingCooldown<=0; tick moves/looks and sets clapping within horizontal2.5 when cooldown==0. Target may come from retaliation, not necessarily a player. Base Goal/TargetGoal/GoalSelector scheduling/continuation and AI reachability remain unexpanded.

Qualified own tick needs clapping+ownalive+cooldown<=0. Counter starts0; modulo8 branch requests clap sound, ENTITY_ROAR, anger-nearby and particle; else-if15 gives other call. Multiples of both take8 branch. These are alarm requests, not add success, and100 is local qualifying-counter threshold rather than a guaranteed100 world-tick duration.

At clapTick>=100, configtrue and !hasAttempted immediately write attemptedtrue BEFORE downward support search, biome lookup, server guard, local existing-Warden and allowed-tag checks. False config leaves flag unspent while counter may continue; later enabling can enter without a fresh100-count period. Config default/assignment do not prove loaded value.

Search begins own block below, descends whileY>-64 and not sturdyUP, and can end at/below-64 with no supported floor. Holder biome is read at search ground position before server guard, not proof the actual child bounding box orY+1 position is safe/eligible. Hardcoded lower bound is not world min-height. No obstruction, full-body free-space or natural cap admission check shown.

Only when server, local Warden query empty and holder tag matches does create occur. No null guard. It moves to own exactX/Z and searchY+1, calls finalizeSpawn(TRIGGERED) using difficulty at original Skreecher block, sets attack target to THIS Skreecher, requests79 anger then calls unchecked addFreshEntity. The originally followed living target is not the target assigned to new Warden. Rejection/null/failed add do not refund flag.

After possible spawn it increments clapTick then server revalidates target alive/LOS/notinvisible/selfnotblind and horizontal<=20; failure calls setClapping(false), which resets counter. This order permits no source-level guarantee target was still eligible before spawn; it is not a reproduced stale-target gameplay event. Target reset and clap interruption do not reset attempted flag.

Nearby Warden AABB is X/Z±35 withY endpoints ownY+(cling?5:25) and-64. Native constructor normalizes all endpoints, so reverse-writtenY does not make it empty. Query is current local returned list, not radius35 sphere, whole-world count, alive/available encounter guarantee, durable lock or atomic reservation. Every8 qualifying iteration requests anger100 for returned Wardens with LOS. No cross-actor exclusivity/duplicate race or actual anger outcome is established.

NBT SummonedWarden serializes hasAttempted, not child UUID/add-result. Clinging/CeilDist/ClingCooldown also saved; clapTick/CLAPPING/jump progress not in own additional data. Complete class has no normal reset of attempted besides reading saved value; setClapping(false) resets counter only. Persistence/reload is conditional on actual engine save/load, not verified. Existing-Warden/biome rejection consumes opportunity; absence of sturdy support has no post-search rejection gate; repeated ordinary clapping will not retry for an already flagged instance.

Own hurt first clears cling/clap and sets200..399 cooldown before delegating super.hurt, without checking its result. Therefore a rejected hurt may still request interruption; neither actual HP decrease nor authoritative successful damage is required by these local mutations. No universal control immunity or native sound/particle rendering guarantee is inferred.

Native Warden.finalizeSpawn sets DIG_COOLDOWN1200, TRIGGERED EMERGING pose and temporary IS_EMERGING plus sound request before parent. setAttackTarget writes Brain attack target and resets roar/reach/sonic cooldown. increaseAngerAt requires !noAI and native canTargetEntity, then changes anger and optional listening feedback. Requests occur before actual add; not successful population/attack receipts. Warden hurt separately can request anger/target after super call independent of its returnedflag; contextual0 credit.

Native ServerLevel addFreshEntity returns addEntity boolean; removed entities rejected, failed entityManager add returnsfalse, success then onAddedToWorld. Caller ignores boolean. EntityManager/Forge join, UUID and chunk/saving internals unexpanded. Warden removeWhenFarAway=false only rejects that ordinary removal policy; complete emerging/digging/Brain lifetime/peaceful/external removal and postspawn survival are not proved.

Actual fixed tag67 bytes declares replacefalse and minecraft:deep_dark. Fixed Git blob/source checks bind resource content, not installed merged tag, dimension rules, config or loaded biome deployment. All registry/native/tag/sound/threshold/attempt/serialization support belongs to at most one AI-alarm/local-suppression/attempt-latch encounter family.

There is NO explicit post-search sturdy-floor rejection gate. The loop may stop atY<=-64 without a sturdyUP face, then still performs biome/server/local-Warden tests and can proceed to create/move/finalize/add if those pass. Unsupported ground is not a demonstrated independent rejection path.

The attempt flag is consumed before search. Biome/local-existing-Warden rejection or a subsequent failed create/add cannot restore it; lack of sturdy support itself does not block the shown spawn path. Do not infer a safe-floor guarantee or a ground-failure no-spawn guard.
